n050536bcbc.summary: Sberbank redirected questions about missing money in the case of police colonel Dmitry Zakharchenko to the Russian Investigative Committee and declined to comment on client operations.
n050536bcbc.why: Sberbank is Russia's largest bank; involvement in a high-profile corruption case may affect its reputation and regulatory scrutiny.
